narrative:

Your checking account status had the largest impact and pushed the decision toward denial. The loan amount of 2,039 DM also helped your case somewhat, as it is noticeably smaller than the 3,020 DM average among those who were approved.

Unfortunately, the negative signal from your checking account outweighed these positive aspects, leading to the final denial.
